s1.ptxt: Check fuel cut valve for operation as follows.

s2.ptxt: Connect special tool (vacuum pump gauge) to fuel EVAP hose (1).

attention3.ptxt: Before using vacuum pump gauge, read its Operator’s Manual to know how to use it.

s2.ptxt: Check that air can be sucked when negative pressure is applied to fuel cut valve.
Using “VACUUM” mode of the special tool, check that air can be sucked when negative pressure is applied to fuel cut valve.
Check that air flows into tank when pressure is applied to fuel cut valve.
Using “PRESSURE” mode of the special tool, check that air flows into tank when pressure is applied to fuel cut valve.

s1.ptxt: If faulty condition is found, replace fuel tank.
